dedupe_keys.name: thyga open access data test results of gas appliances with hydrogen and natural gas blends

description: THyGA, Testing Hydrogen Admixtures for Gas Appliances, was a European project selected under the 2019 work programme of the Fuel Cells and Hydrogen Joint Undertaking to understand the impact of natural gas and hydrogen blends on residential and commercial gas appliances and to recommend changes to codes and standards. Its open access data page, read on 2026-09-26, holds three items posted on 20 June 2023: an Excel sheet with all anonymised test results used for the figures of report D3.8, the test protocol (version 10, September 2022) with the Excel datasheet partners used to report results, and an Excel tool to calculate the oxygen percentage for appliance adjustment described in deliverable D5.2. Coverage is appliances on the European market tested in partner laboratories. Files are free downloads; the site states no licence but asks users to mention THyGA, the European Commission and the Clean Hydrogen Partnership. Caveats: results are anonymised by appliance, the project has ended, and blends and test conditions follow the project protocol, so they may not match every national gas quality. Simulation uses are setting safe blend limits in capacity planning for hydrogen injection into distribution networks and assessing appliance-side risks for resilience of gas supply. Related records: model-blendpath-hydrogen-blending-pipeline-tool analyses blending on pipelines, and data-ena-smarter-networks-innovation-portal lists GB hydrogen trials.
